name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support for eligible landholding farmer families through direct benefit transfers.
benefits: Up to Rs 6,000 per year in three equal instalments
Direct transfer to the registered bank account
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer family
Valid Aadhaar and bank account details
Subject to government exclusion criteria
application_process: Register through the PM-KISAN portal or local agriculture office
Complete land and Aadhaar verification
Track application and instalments online

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance against notified natural risks and post-harvest losses.
benefits: Insurance cover for notified crops and areas
Support for crop loss caused by covered risks
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Policy and premium submission before the seasonal deadline
application_process: Check the notified crop and deadline
Apply through the insurer, bank, CSC, or PMFBY portal
Report losses through the prescribed channel within the deadline

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Flexible short-term credit for crop production, post-harvest needs, and allied activities.
benefits: Working capital for cultivation and allied activities
Interest support may apply under current government guidelines
eligibility: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and eligible self-help groups
Credit assessment by the lending institution
application_process: Apply at a participating bank or through its digital channel
Submit land, identity, and cultivation details
Complete bank verification and sanction process

name: National Agriculture Market
description: A pan-India electronic trading platform connecting agricultural produce markets.
benefits: Access to wider buyer participation
Transparent price discovery and online trade
eligibility: Farmers and farmer producer organisations using participating mandis
Produce must meet the market and quality requirements
application_process: Register with a participating mandi or e-NAM help desk
Complete farmer and bank details
List produce through the participating market

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
description: Support for cluster-based organic farming and certification.
benefits: Support for organic inputs and cluster activities
Assistance for participatory guarantee and marketing activities
eligibility: Farmers participating in approved organic farming clusters
Compliance with the programme organic standards
application_process: Join an approved cluster through the state agriculture department
Prepare the organic conversion plan
Complete group certification and reporting

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan
description: Support for solar pumps and decentralised renewable energy for agriculture.
benefits: Assistance for eligible solar irrigation pump components
Lower irrigation energy costs where approved
eligibility: Farmers and eligible farmer groups
Subject to component, state, and distribution company guidelines
application_process: Check the state implementing agency notification
Apply through the state portal or designated agency
Complete technical and beneficiary verification

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Soil testing and nutrient recommendations for balanced crop input use.
benefits: Soil nutrient test report
Crop-wise fertiliser and soil management recommendations
eligibility: Farmers with cultivable land in participating areas
application_process: Contact the nearest soil testing laboratory or agriculture office
Provide field location and sample
Collect the generated soil health card

name: Kerala State Crop Insurance Scheme
description: State crop insurance support for eligible notified crops cultivated in Kerala.
benefits: Compensation for covered crop losses
Coverage and premium support as notified by Kerala
eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified crops in Kerala
Enrollment before the notified seasonal deadline
application_process: Contact the Krishi Bhavan or Kerala agriculture portal
Submit crop and land details
Report damage through the notified local process

name: Kerala Farm Mechanization Assistance
description: State assistance for approved agricultural machinery and custom hiring services in Kerala.
benefits: Subsidy support for approved farm machinery
Improved access through eligible custom hiring centres
eligibility: Kerala farmers and eligible farmer groups
Equipment must be approved under the active notification
application_process: Check the current Kerala agriculture department notification
Apply through the Krishi Bhavan or designated portal
Complete quotation and field verification

name: Tamil Nadu Crop Insurance Support
description: State-facilitated crop insurance enrollment and loss support for notified crops in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Insurance access for notified crops and areas
Support for reporting and assessing covered crop losses
eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified crops in Tamil Nadu
Valid enrollment within the notified season
application_process: Apply through the agriculture office, bank, CSC, or notified portal
Submit crop and land details
Report losses through the local agriculture authority

name: Tamil Nadu Agricultural Mechanization Assistance
description: Assistance for approved agricultural machinery and farm equipment for Tamil Nadu farmers.
benefits: Subsidy support for eligible machinery
Reduced cultivation and post-harvest handling costs
eligibility: Tamil Nadu farmers and eligible farmer groups
Equipment and beneficiary must meet the current department notification
application_process: Check the Tamil Nadu agriculture department notification
Apply through the designated agriculture office or portal
Complete document and field verification
